summary: Phase 4 Red tests committed and run at HEAD 9019a792. Target suites fail for the intended Phase 4 reasons: `gameCompletions` table is missing from the schema/migrations, `recordGameCompletion` has no DB-level race-safe fire-once constraint (concurrent idempotent inserts both succeed), `leaderboards.schoolId` is nullable, `getSchoolLeaderboard` and `leaderboardResponseSchema` are not exported, and the host progress mutations `recordActivity`/`updateLessonProgress` accept invalid payloads without Zod validation. Existing tests in the touched files continue to pass.
blocking_findings: Missing tenant-safe persistence table: `gameCompletions` is not exported from `@reading-advantage/db/schema`, causing `packages/domain/src/__tests__/games-live.test.ts` 4A and 4E to fail with migration-missing errors.

Race-safe fire-once gap: `packages/domain/src/games/mutations.ts#recordGameCompletion` relies only on `SELECT-before-INSERT`; concurrent calls with the same `idempotencyKey` both succeed (`insert count: 2`). Phase 4 Red requires the `xpLogs` unique constraint `(userId, activityId)` (or equivalent `gameCompletions` unique constraint) to guarantee exactly one insert.

Leaderboards nullable tenant column: `packages/db/src/schema/primary.ts#leaderboards` has `schoolId` nullable, so 4C inserts without `schoolId` succeed; the notNull migration required by Decision 4.4 is missing.

Missing domain leaderboard query: `getSchoolLeaderboard` is not exported from `packages/domain/src/games/queries.js`, and `leaderboardResponseSchema` is not exported from `@reading-advantage/domain/games`. 4D/4E/4F tests fail at module resolution.

Host progress mutation validation gap (D-06 Tier 1): `packages/domain/src/progress/mutations.ts#recordActivity` and `#updateLessonProgress` accept empty `activityType`, `xpEarned: 999`, oversized metadata, unknown keys, non-UUID `lessonId`, invalid `status` enum, and `progress` outside 0..100. Phase 4 Red requires `.strict()` Zod schemas.
evidence: Commit 9019a792 adds `packages/domain/src/__tests__/games-live.test.ts`, `packages/domain/src/__tests__/helpers/testDb.ts`, extends `packages/domain/src/__tests__/games.test.ts`, rewrites `apps/advantage-games/src/lib/games/api/rankingRoute.test.ts`, adds `@electric-sql/pglite` to `packages/domain/package.json`, and updates `measure/tracks/wave3_product_alignment_20260628/plan.md`.

PGlite live-DB harness mirrors the marketing app helper pattern. It runs real drizzle migration SQL in journal order, skipping only the pgcrypto `digest()` migration which PGlite does not support; this does not affect Phase 4 persistence behavior.
Domain suite with `-- games-live`: 450 unrelated tests pass; 13 new Phase 4 Red tests fail for the intended missing-behavior reasons.
Jest route suite: 5/7 rankingRoute tests pass (existing config/structure); 2/7 fail on missing `leaderboardResponseSchema` and legacy `normal` difficulty key.
Lint and type-check gates are clean on both `@reading-advantage/domain` and `vocabulary-games`.
